name: 26-akhekh
description: Akhekh: a tan antelope body with two big blue and teal bird wings spread, a falcon's head crowned with three small gold cobras, and a green serpent tail. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Hovering in place, one full wingbeat: both blue wings sweep up high above its back, then beat down below the body, then back. Body, falcon head, crown and tail stay level. Same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
